title: Ian's Zoo Day
goal: Children name common zoo animals and say one thing about each.
before: Ask: who has been to a zoo? Which animals live there?
pause: Which animal is that? | What sound does it make? | Is it big or small?
after: Ask each child: which animal was your favourite, and why?
activity: Animal walk. Call out an animal from the episode and let the children move like it: stomp, hop, waddle or swing. No materials needed.

title: Ian's Little Garden
goal: Children tell the order: seed, soil, water, sun, plant.
before: Show a real seed. Ask: what do you think will grow from this?
pause: What does a plant need to grow? | What did Ian do to help? | What grows from a seed?
after: Ask the children to tell the steps back in order, using their hands to show the plant growing.
activity: Cup garden. Each child puts a bean seed on wet cotton in a clear cup by the window. Check it every morning and talk about what changed.

title: Ian's Shape Hunt
goal: Children recognise and name a circle, a square and a triangle.
before: Draw a circle, a square and a triangle on the board. Ask: do you know these shapes?
pause: What shape is that? | How many corners does a triangle have? | Can you see that shape in our room?
after: Ask: which shape has no corners? Which one has four?
activity: Classroom shape hunt. Draw one big shape on each of three sheets of paper. Children find objects in the room and place them on the matching sheet.

title: Ian's Number Walk
goal: Children count objects from 1 to 5, one number for each object.
before: Hold up your fingers one at a time and count to five together.
pause: How many can you see? | Can you count with Ian on your fingers? | What number comes after 3?
after: Line up five toys and count them together. Take one away and count again.
activity: Counting walk. Walk around the playground and collect five leaves, stones or sticks each. Sit in a circle and count them out loud together.

title: Ian's Color Day
goal: Children name six colors: red, blue, yellow, orange, green and purple.
before: Hold up a red, a blue and a yellow crayon. Ask: who knows these colors?
pause: What color is that? | Can you find something in our room that is the same color? | What is your favourite color so far?
after: Ask each child to name one color from the episode and point to something that color.
activity: Color sort. Put a pile of crayons, blocks or paper scraps in the middle. Children sort them into six groups, one for each color, and name each group together.

title: Ian's Snowy Day
goal: Children name winter clothes (hat, scarf, gloves, boots, coat) and say why we wear them when it is cold.
before: Show a hat, a scarf or a glove. Ask: when do we wear this? Is it for a hot day or a cold day?
pause: What is falling outside the window? | What does Ian put on to stay warm? | What did they make with the snow?
after: Ask each child to name one thing Ian wore in the snow and point to where it goes on the body.
activity: Dress for snow. Put a pile of hats, scarves, gloves and coats from the dress-up box or lost-and-found in the middle. Children take turns putting on one item and saying its name, then the class counts how many items the child is wearing.

title: Ian's Christmas Eve
goal: Children name Christmas things like a tree, star, bell, lights, present, ribbon and bow, and say what we do with them.
before: Show a small wrapped box or a piece of ribbon. Ask: what is this? When do people give presents?
pause: What is Ian putting on the tree? | Can you find a star or a bell? | What do we use to wrap a present?
after: Ask each child to name one thing from the episode they would put on a Christmas tree.
activity: Wrap a present. Give each pair of children a small box or block, a sheet of scrap paper and a piece of string. They wrap it together, tie a bow, and say each step out loud: box, paper, string, bow.
